rules.rule: Never increase a source-category count until a complete source-vs-repository diff reconciles additions and removals.
PQ 36 remains a numbering gap unless a primary or authoritative source establishes a distinct final record.
Super/Ultimate/Evasive variants must be represented separately from canonical skill identity when source categorization requires it.
Every factual record must retain at least one source and a verification status.
Records that originate from DLC, PQs, mentors, shops or other systems must expose those relationships rather than duplicating disconnected facts.
Conflicting costs, effects, unlocks or acquisition claims are stored as source conflicts until reconciled.
A domain is not complete when only names/counts exist; required fields must be populated or explicitly unresolved.
